newsitem.title: CANADA: Nav Canada closes C$750 million bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Nav Canada closes C$750 million bond issue.

text.p: Nav Canada on Monday said it closed its initial public offering of C$750 million in revenue bonds and that the offer was fully subscribed.

Nav Canada, a non-profit entity that runs Canada's air traffic control system, had priced the bonds on December 5. The issue was one of the largest public offerings of corporate bonds in Canadian history.
The issue was underwritten by a sydicate lead by RBC Dominion Securities Inc, and split into three equally-sized tranches with maturities of six, 10, and 30 years.
The bonds were issued by Nav Canada to repay part of the C$3 billion bank debt the organization incurred when it bought the air navigation system from the Government of Canada.
